name: Aegis Shard
sequence: Shield fragments assemble; shield tilts; shield ruptures forward; golden shards strike center; fragments ricochet; bronze dust sprays; fragments fall; a few gold flecks fade

name: Olympian Spark
sequence: A thumb-sized cloud gathers; tendrils charge; first fork snaps down; two forks strike outward; small thunder splash; cloud curls away; smoke thins; tiny static sparks die

name: Trident Surge
sequence: A low water bulge appears; a bronze trident rises inside; trident lunges through a curling wave; wave crashes onto the ground; white foam splashes wide; water spills into streams; droplets fall; foam recedes

name: Gorgon Gaze
sequence: Wisps reveal a stone gorgon face; snakes uncoil; green eyes flare; twin eye beams strike the ground; a stone crust spreads; crust cracks into chips; face recedes into green dust; stone chips settle

name: Titan Javelin
sequence: A small dust spiral forms; enormous bronze javelin appears overhead; spear plunges tip down; spear strikes and marble fractures; large stone chips erupt; shaft dissolves into bronze dust; rubble falls; dust settles

name: Olympian Tempest
sequence: A wide storm cloud grows; three cloud lobes spiral; lightning winds between them; multiple forks strike separate ground points; wind rips cloud open; wisps scatter; rain falls; cloud dissolves

name: Judgment of Olympus
sequence: Golden clouds part; colossal divine hand emerges; hand lifts jagged thunderbolt; bolt slams vertically into broken marble; thick electrical branches race over debris; hand withdraws; clouds shed gold dust; final embers settle

name: Sea Kings Wrath
sequence: Tidal foam coils on the floor; a sea-horse shape rises; crowned water horse rears; enormous wave folds over and crashes; spray bursts sideways; turquoise water spreads; wave collapses into ripples; pearl foam fades

name: Rime Needle
sequence: Cold mist gathers; needle of ice grows; needle extends sharply; needle shatters on contact; fine icy splinters spray; shards tumble; frost fog disperses; last crystals melt

name: Raven Talon
sequence: Black feathers gather; raven forms with wings raised; raven dives claws first; talons rake three curved slashes; raven banks sharply; wings dissolve to feathers; feathers spiral down; faint shadow vanishes

name: Glacier Fang
sequence: Frozen earth bulges; broad ice fang forces upward; fang grows tall; fang bursts into jagged shards; shards fly outward; cold vapor rolls low; crystal pieces fall; snow settles

name: Rune Shatter
sequence: Rough stone tablet rises; old runic cuts glow; tablet fractures along grooves; rock splits violently into large slabs; fragments rotate apart; small stone chips fall; rune glow drains; dust settles

name: Fenrir Bite
sequence: Broken chain links emerge; wolf muzzle forms in cold mist; huge jaws open; fangs snap closed at center; chain bursts apart; wolf snarls and pulls back; fur fades into vapor; iron fragments settle

name: Winter Sundering
sequence: A narrow fissure opens; two glacier slabs rise; slabs pull apart; blue frost surges between them; frozen shockwave spreads; jagged ice crumbles; blizzard thins; snow powder settles

name: Ragnarok Hammer
sequence: Iron chain sparks gather; large rune hammer materializes high; hammer swings downward diagonally; hammer crushes an anvil in an orange-white impact; chunks of iron and lightning burst; hammer swings through; debris falls; sparks extinguish

name: Fimbulwinter
sequence: Snow begins circling; bare frost tree rises; branches rapidly freeze; a heavy blizzard tears through the tree; limbs splinter into icicles; ice storm spreads low; spectral tree dissolves; snow quietly settles

name: Sun Needle
sequence: Small solar bead forms; bead sharpens to gold needle; needle stretches downward; point pierces and flashes; amber sparks split in narrow rays; rays contract; gold dust drifts; light fades

name: Scarab Sting
sequence: Grains of sand gather; turquoise scarab spreads gold wings; scarab lunges with raised stinger; stinger strikes and green-gold venom splashes; wings snap shut; scarab crumbles into sand; sandy chitin falls; dust settles

name: Desert Glass
sequence: A patch of sand swirls; sand rises in a small funnel; heat melts it into amber glass; jagged glass blades burst outward; blades fracture; amber shards rotate down; remaining sand slips away; glittering dust settles

name: Cobra Crown
sequence: Gold sand spirals; cobra hood rises; snake rears with open fangs; cobra snaps down with two venom arcs; venom spatters across ground; serpent recoils; hood dissolves into golden scales; a few scales fade

name: Solar Lance
sequence: Solar disk ignites; long golden lance forms below it; lance thrusts down; white-hot spearpoint strikes; sharp rays break sideways; lance dissolves from tip upward; glowing gold flecks float; radiance dwindles

name: Pyramid Nova
sequence: Sand piles into steps; sandstone pyramid assembles; seams glow from within; pyramid splits open in a brilliant solar eruption; separate stone blocks levitate; sun contracts; blocks crumble to sand; sand settles

name: Judgment of Anubis
sequence: Dark sand raises gold scales; black jackal silhouette appears behind; a glowing feather tips one scale; opposite pan plunges and a soul-shaped light is drawn upward; jackal eyes flare; scales break into sand; dark veil withdraws; single gold feather fades

name: Ra Ascendant
sequence: Sun rises inside a gold disk; falcon head and wings emerge; enormous falcon spreads wings; falcon sweeps burning wings down; golden flame feathers rain outward; wings lift and disintegrate; sun shrinks; glowing feathers fade

name: Fox Ember
sequence: Small orange ember bounces; fox head forms; fox leaps in a tight arc; fox dives into a curling tongue of flame; tails flare into nine ribbons; flame ribbons scatter; blue-tipped embers rise; final ember winks out

name: Paper Blade
sequence: Folded paper appears; paper unfolds into a crane; wings snap into long blades; crane makes a sharp slicing pass; paper blades separate into fluttering slips; slips fold and tumble; pieces drift apart; final paper flecks fade

name: Oni Flame
sequence: Red smoke gathers; oni mask emerges; mask opens its tusked mouth; a ragged horizontal fire breath erupts; flames roll over the floor; mask cracks and retracts; embers tumble; smoke dissipates

name: Mirror Shatter
sequence: A round bronze mirror appears edge-on; mirror rotates to face viewer; spiderweb cracks cross silver glass; mirror shatters explosively; fragments reflect several little moons; silver shards fall; bronze rim fades; last glints disappear

name: Dragon Comet
sequence: Long golden comet tail appears; jade dragon emerges within it; dragon twists into a dive; dragon's head strikes and tail whips around; starry dust curls in a long spiral; dragon dissolves scale by scale; little stars fall; dust clears

name: Thousand Lanterns
sequence: One red lantern ignites; three lanterns unfold; many lanterns rise in an uneven procession; lanterns burst into separate golden flames; burning paper flutters; flames ascend; small embers float away; lantern ashes fade

name: Raijins Verdict
sequence: Red thunder drums appear in a semicircle; drumsticks lift; storm hands strike alternating drums; final simultaneous beat releases jagged branching lightning; drums recoil and sparks burst; drums dissolve into rain; cloud wisps retreat; final electric flicker fades

name: Amaterasus Dawn
sequence: Bronze sacred mirror opens; crimson dawn disk rises behind; crane wings spread from the disk; wide golden sunrays sweep downward; white feather silhouettes drift through sunlight; mirror slowly closes; rays soften; a few bright feathers fade

name: Briar Dart
sequence: Green bud appears; thorn curls out; briar dart straightens; thorn stabs sharply downward; small leaves snap loose; thorn retracts; leaf fragments drift; a berry-red spark fades

name: Wisp Sting
sequence: Small blue wisp appears; wisp draws a curved trail; thorny vine follows its loop; wisp dives and stings with bright green point; tiny wing-like motes scatter; vine uncoils; leaves drift; wisp shrinks away

name: Oak Spear
sequence: Acorn splits; twisted oak shaft grows; bronze-bound spearhead emerges; oak spear thrusts into earth; bark cracks and leaves burst outward; wood splinters; leaves tumble down; dust settles

name: Thorn Spiral
sequence: Roots curl at ground level; thorny brambles twist upward; corkscrew tightens; spiral constricts violently and thorns flare; bramble snaps; vine fragments unwind; leaves and thorns fall; roots withdraw

name: Moon Hunt
sequence: Silver crescent forms; white stag steps from moonlight; stag lowers antlers and charges; antlers sweep in a broad silver strike; stag leaps upward; silhouette breaks into moonlit leaves; silver dust floats; crescent fades

name: Wildwood Reckoning
sequence: Soil bulges with roots; ancient oak trunk tears upward; angry wooden face opens; huge roots lash outward in several directions; bark and earth explode; branches recoil; leaves rain; stump sinks into the earth

name: Morrigans Flight
sequence: One raven circles; three ravens split from its shadow; flock dives in a triangular sweep; wings slash across center leaving crimson trails; ravens bank upward; forms dissolve into dark feathers; feathers tumble; shadow thins

name: Lughs Judgment
sequence: Sunlit oak leaf hangs; bronze spear assembles along a sunbeam; spear draws back; long leaf blade cleaves downward; bright wooden splinters and golden leaves scatter; shaft dissolves; gold pollen drifts; sunbeam fades

name: Jade Fang
sequence: Jade chips gather; curved fang takes shape; gold bands tighten; fang bites down with a green crack; jade shards fly; fragments rotate; green dust falls; last glint fades

name: Obsidian Splinter
sequence: Small black glass flake rises; flake sharpens into long spike; copper-red seams glow; obsidian splinter bursts violently; black shards scatter; red embers trail; smoke curls away; fragments settle

name: Serpent Coil
sequence: Scaled tail curls; turquoise serpent coils upward; feathered head rears; coils suddenly constrict and fangs snap; jade scale fragments spray; serpent unwinds; loose feathers drift; tail fades

name: Jaguar Eclipse
sequence: Copper eclipse disk dims; spotted jaguar emerges from darkness; cat crouches then leaps; paws rake three long copper slashes; jaguar passes through eclipse; shadow dissolves into spots; copper dust falls; disk fades

name: Star Calendar
sequence: Carved calendar ring appears; stone segments rotate; blue star shines at center; ring splits and star pulses outward; carved slabs orbit then scatter; stone chips fall; starlight contracts; dust settles

name: Volcanic Crown
sequence: Cracked black crown rises; seams fill with lava; smoke billows upward; jagged crown erupts with molten jets; hot rock chunks fly; lava drips and cools; ash settles; last orange cracks darken

name: Feathered Serpent Descent
sequence: Long feathered tail appears overhead; huge serpent body winds into view; magnificent jade and scarlet head dives; serpent plunges into ground and feathers fan outward; long body coils through a second sweeping arc; scales become fluttering feathers; feathers fall; turquoise dust clears

name: Heart of the Sun
sequence: Small gold heart beats; molten veins glow; heart swells between turquoise rays; heart bursts into a hot sun with long jagged rays; molten drops rain outward; sun contracts into burning seed; gold ashes drift; ember fades

name: Arcane Needle
sequence: Violet mote condenses; thin crystal needle grows; needle turns point downward; needle pierces and fractures; purple slivers scatter; silver dust spirals; crystal chips fall; violet glow fades

name: Searing Cinder
sequence: Dull coal appears; cracks glow orange; cinder flares upward; small compact fireburst erupts; glowing charcoal fragments scatter; smoke rises; red embers fall; final coal darkens

name: Crystal Lance
sequence: Quartz shards gather; large amethyst lance forms; spear twists toward ground; crystal lance shatters on impact; faceted fragments explode outward; prisms tumble; violet dust falls; last sparkle fades

name: Gravity Bloom
sequence: Tiny black point appears; stones lift around it; silver arcs bend inward; gravity well collapses into a dense black sphere; dust and rocks spiral tightly inward; sphere shrinks; one outward ripple escapes; all light returns

name: Astral Execution
sequence: Small star opens; long silver celestial blade emerges; blade draws back overhead; blade cleaves vertically through a violet nebula; bright shards shoot sideways; blade dissolves upward; falling stardust lingers; star closes

name: Comet Convergence
sequence: Three small comets appear at different edges; long separate tails grow; comets converge toward center; three cores collide into a many-pointed white gold burst; distinct broken tails sweep outward; fragments arc down; stars drift; final dust fades
